meta.title: PyPI workflow
meta.description: Query PyPI packages and releases, publish distributions with the built-in zero-dependency uploader, check name availability, and manage account credentials and tracked projects in settings.

panel.title: PyPI workflow
panel.hintToken: The token is written only to the local DSH credential store ($DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml) and never appears in configuration or in the conversation.
panel.hintTokenScope: Prefer a project-scoped token from pypi.org "Account settings -> API tokens" over an account-wide token.
panel.emptyProjects: No tracked projects yet. Publishing adds one automatically, or add one manually below.
panel.unverified: Unverified: a PyPI token only works against the upload API, so it cannot be checked offline; the first publish returns the real result.
